selection.method: weakest-three equal-opponent rank scores; mean ranks tie-break; round-robin one axis
selection.caveat: Selection-set result only. Confirm on a fresh seed before deployment; no ladder-strength or Nash claim.

execution.teacher_matchups: One remote CPU thread after completion of original training; read-only model access, no remote file writes.
execution.student_and_residual_matchups: Local CPU; identical deck schedule and actor RNG scheme.

evidence_scope: Pair totals and hashes are included. Model binaries, per-hand raw logs, host paths and online session tokens are excluded.

slumbot_smoke.purpose: Connectivity and replay only; no strength conclusion.
